verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Honeybadger auto-resolves errors on deploy, offers resolve/reopen buttons in Slack, and lets users choose which error events trigger notifications. However, no item documents that an error recurring after resolution is detected as a regression or alerted on separately from new errors. Those features are adjacent and do not show regression alerting itself.

support.subject: As an SRE, I get alerted when an error that was fixed comes back in a newer release, distinct from ordinary new-issue noise
